title: Prescription review
subtitle: Review every field before confirming your prescription.

sections.title: Import prescription
sections.note: Upload PNG or JPG, or enter instructions manually. OCR text stays editable.

sections.title: Review extracted instructions
sections.note: Synthetic demonstration only. Match these fields to the original prescription.

side: Confirming saves a new version; earlier records remain.
successBody: The reviewed instructions were saved. Version 1 is still available in history. You can now preview a schedule.
errorBody: Quantity per dose is missing. Enter a positive quantity and its unit before confirming. Your draft is retained.
invalidField: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
empty: No prescription yet. Upload an image or start manual entry.
loading: Extracting text… You can switch to manual entry.
failure: Image extraction failed. Keep the image and enter or correct the draft manually.

title: Schedule builder
subtitle: Build a schedule from confirmed prescription instructions.

sections.title: Confirmed instruction
sections.note: Source: prescription version 2. Unconfirmed drafts cannot create active schedules.

sections.title: Schedule settings
sections.note: Preview all occurrences before confirming. Editing creates a new version.

side: Pause stops future reminders; past dose history remains.
successBody: Seven planned occurrences were saved for 2–8 November. Reminders use Asia/Dhaka. You can pause or revise future scheduling.
errorBody: The end date is before the start date. Correct the date range and preview again. No schedule was activated.
empty: No confirmed prescription. Review and confirm instructions first.
failure: Preview could not load. Your inputs remain; retry before confirming.

title: Medicine cabinet
subtitle: Search for a medicine and choose the matching identity.

sections.title: Search medicine terminology
sections.note: Search uses RxNorm. Check name, strength and form; a result is a candidate, not a verified prescription.

sections.title: Selected candidate
sections.note: Prototype search data is illustrative. Manual entries are labelled user-entered.

side: Edit details or archive items; referenced history stays available.
successBody: The selected identity and source reference were saved. You can open its information card, edit details or archive it later.
errorBody: The terminology service did not respond. Retry the search or enter a clearly labelled manual medicine. No candidate was silently selected.
invalidField: Enter at least one non-space character.
empty: No matching candidate. Try another term or enter medicine details manually.
failure: Search timed out. Retry or use manual entry.

title: Medicine information
subtitle: Read source passages and keep your own notes separately.

sections.title: Selected medicine and source
fields: No real label selected in prototype
sections.note: A source URL, label identifier and retrieval time appear only after a matching label is selected.

sections.title: Label passages
fields: Matching source passage will appear here.
Matching source passage will appear here.
sections.note: These are placeholders, not medicine guidance. Personal notes are never presented as label evidence.

sections.title: Personal note
fields: Ask the pharmacist about the label match.
sections.note: Visible only to people with permission for this patient.

side: No claim of a successful live retrieval
No matching label → show information unavailable.
successBody: Your note was saved separately from source passages. Saving a note does not validate a label match or change medicine instructions.
errorBody: No suitable source label was found. No warnings or storage instructions are inferred. You can retry or return to the cabinet.
empty: No matching source label. Information unavailable.
failure: Label service unavailable. Keep the note and retry source retrieval.

title: Caregiver tasks
subtitle: Assign care tasks and keep a clear handover history.

sections.title: Create a task
fields: Check the saved list before collection.
sections.note: Only authorized caregivers can receive and update patient tasks.

sections.title: Telegram notifications
sections.note: Channel acceptance and human acknowledgement are tracked separately.

side: Timeline records assignment, acceptance, completion and reopening.
successBody: The open task and its handover note were saved. A notification job is queued; delivery and acknowledgement remain separate.
errorBody: This assignee no longer has access. Select an active authorized caregiver. The task was not assigned and no notification was sent.
invalidField: Choose a caregiver with active task permission.
empty: No tasks yet. Create one for an authorized caregiver.
failure: Task board could not load. Retry; do not assume a task was saved.

title: Today’s doses
subtitle: Record what happened for each scheduled occurrence.

sections.title: Due at 08:00
sections.note: Choose Taken or Skipped. Snooze moves the reminder and keeps the scheduled dose unchanged.

sections.title: Reminder and recent history
fields: Accepted by Telegram · not proof of reading
sections.note: No response becomes overdue–unconfirmed after the waiting period, never automatically skipped.

side: Repeated clicks return the same record.
Stock deduction is tracked once; correction keeps history.
successBody: The 08:00 occurrence is now Taken. A repeated request does not create another action or stock deduction. Corrections require a reason.
errorBody: The connection failed before confirmation. Check the latest dose status and retry using the same request. Do not display Taken until the server confirms.
empty: No doses scheduled today. Open the confirmed schedule to review future doses.
failure: Dose records unavailable. Retry; reminder delivery is not proof a dose was taken.
